entries.label: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
entries.description: Reflected/HTML-context script injection verified by unescaped reflection.

entries.label: SQL Injection
entries.description: Error/boolean/time-based SQL injection across query, body and JSON points.

entries.label: NoSQL Injection
entries.description: Operator injection ($ne/$gt/$regex) against JSON/NoSQL APIs.

entries.label: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI)
entries.description: Template expression evaluation verified with unique arithmetic products.

entries.label: OS Command Injection / RCE
entries.description: Command separators detected via command output or a confirmed timing delay.

entries.label: LFI / Path Traversal
entries.description: Local file inclusion and directory traversal with multiple encodings.

entries.label: XML External Entity (XXE)
entries.description: In-band/OOB external entity expansion against XML endpoints.

entries.label: LDAP Injection
entries.description: LDAP filter injection in authentication/search parameters.

entries.label: XPath Injection
entries.description: XPath query injection with error/boolean differential checks.

entries.label: CRLF / Header Injection
entries.description: Carriage-return/line-feed injection into response headers or logs.

entries.label: HTTP Parameter Pollution
entries.description: Duplicate parameters that change server-side interpretation.

entries.label: Insecure Deserialization
entries.description: Unsafe object deserialization indicators (Java/PHP/Python/.NET).

entries.label: Type Juggling
entries.description: Loose type comparison bypass in authentication/authorization.

entries.label: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
entries.description: Internal/cloud-metadata fetch and blind OAST callback verification.

entries.label: Open Redirect
entries.description: Location header points to an external attacker-controlled domain.

entries.label: Host Header Injection
entries.description: Untrusted Host/X-Forwarded-Host reflected into links or redirects.

entries.label: Web Cache Poisoning
entries.description: Unkeyed header/parameter poisoning of shared caches.

entries.label: HTTP Request Smuggling
entries.description: CL.TE / TE.CL desynchronization between front-end and back-end.

entries.label: Prototype Pollution
entries.description: Client/server-side prototype pollution through recursive merges.

entries.label: File Upload Bypass
entries.description: Extension/MIME/content-type bypass leading to executable uploads.

entries.label: WebSocket Security
entries.description: Unauthenticated WebSocket access and message injection/XSS.

entries.label: DOM-based XSS
entries.description: Source→sink execution confirmed in a real headless browser.

entries.label: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
entries.description: State-changing forms without anti-CSRF tokens or Origin checks.

entries.label: Clickjacking
entries.description: Missing X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors on sensitive pages.

entries.label: CORS Misconfiguration
entries.description: ACAO reflects an untrusted Origin, optionally with credentials.

entries.label: IDOR / BOLA
entries.description: Object-level authorization bypass confirmed with a second identity.

entries.label: Broken Access Control
entries.description: 403 bypass, forced browsing and missing function-level authorization.

entries.label: JWT Weaknesses
entries.description: alg:none, alg confusion, weak secrets and missing expiry.

entries.label: GraphQL Security
entries.description: Introspection enabled, unbounded depth/complexity, batching abuse.

entries.label: Mass Assignment (BOPLA)
entries.description: Privileged properties accepted from client-controlled JSON bodies.

entries.label: Missing Rate Limit / Brute Force
entries.description: Login/OTP/reset endpoints allow unlimited attempts.

entries.label: Information Disclosure
entries.description: Exposed .git/.env/backup/config files and verbose errors.

entries.label: Secret / API-key Exposure
entries.description: Live credentials, tokens and private keys in client-served assets.

entries.label: Subdomain Takeover
entries.description: Dangling DNS records pointing to unclaimed third-party resources.

entries.label: Missing Security Headers
entries.description: Missing CSP/HSTS/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy.

entries.label: Weak TLS / HSTS
entries.description: Legacy TLS versions, weak ciphers or missing HSTS.

entries.label: Race Condition
entries.description: Concurrent requests produce duplicate/unauthorized state transitions.

entries.label: Business Logic Flaws
entries.description: Price/quantity tampering, workflow bypass and privilege escalation.

entries.label: AI / LLM Prompt Injection
entries.description: Untrusted input overrides LLM instructions or leaks system prompts. Tested by the AI agent.

entries.label: Server-Side Prototype Pollution
entries.description: Prototype chain pollution on the server leading to RCE/DoS. Tested by the AI agent.
